thread:
Eleni: Quick follow-up: propose an "admission" phase before scoring to filter incompatible routes (region/tier/model-family). Keeps scorer deterministic. Thoughts?
Sam: So admission removes candidates early? Could be big perf win.
Jorge: Concern: admission cost could add tail. How cheap is it?
Mei: Plan: per-route metadata cache in resolver, TTL 20s, shard by route_id mod N to avoid thundering. Lookups are local.
Priya: Need explainability + billing trace for preemption. Ops will need a compact reject code.
Eleni: Agree: emit up to 2 reject entries per request (route, short-code). Add optional preempted_snapshot only when tenant-level gating occurs. Default off.
Sam: Rollout: shadow -> soft-deprioritize -> hard-admit. Soft includes a bias instead of full remove.
Jorge: Safety: if admission would remove all above-quality variants, fallback keep top-quality route.
Mei: Proto shape: candidates: "r1,r2" admit_summary: "r3:RM:1;r4:TT:2" (route:code:pred_idx). Simple parser in SDK.
Priya: Metrics: admit_total, admit_reject_by_code, admit_latency_ms, admit_skipped. Docs and console columns needed.
Eleni: I'll draft addendum with API shape, predicate registry, cache defaults, rollout checklist. Target review by EOD Fri.
ops-bot: perf-run #1430: admit cache hit 99.1%, avg admit latency 0.8ms, p95 end-to-end improved 5.4% for 50 candidates.
